narrative.overview: Everforest Complete disappears behind the work. Forest-tinted surfaces reduce glare while semantic accents make state changes immediately legible.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained forest neutrals with semantic accent color.
Eight shipped themes: six fixed Soft, Medium, and Hard presets plus two configurable Light and Dark themes.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Accent color communicates meaning; it never decorates empty space.

rules.name: The User Font Rule
rules.body: Never bundle, download, or force a font.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Change surface tone before adding shadow.

dos: Do compile every theme through src/theme.ts.
Do preserve all eight shipped theme labels and paths during upgrades.
Do keep premium controls application-scoped, local, and reversible.
donts: Don't add paid feature gates, trials, upgrade prompts, or artificial limits.
Don't ship generic recolors that ignore workbench, extension, terminal, or interaction states.
Don't duplicate theme logic or add speculative settings.
